US.description: Federal, state, and local income taxes, plus FICA (Social Security and Medicare).

IN.description: Includes federal income tax (new regime) and a 4% health and education cess for an $85k USD earner.

SG.description: Effective income tax rate, based on progressive tax brackets.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, and communal income taxes, plus social security contributions.

NL.description: Includes progressive income tax and social security contributions, factoring in standard tax credits.

GB.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax and national insurance contributions for an earner making $85k USD (approx. £67,150 GBP).

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes for an $85k USD earner in Ontario, deductions not fully accounted.

AE.description: Zero personal income tax for individuals; VAT applies to most goods and services.

NO.description: Includes municipal and federal income tax, national insurance contributions, and progressive surtaxes.

IE.description: Includes income tax (PAYE), Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI).

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax, social security contributions (pension, health, dependency insurance), and unemployment fund contributions for a single earner.

AU.description: Effective rate including federal income tax and Medicare levy for an $85k USD equivalent earner ($127,500 AUD) under current 2023-2024 tax rules.

QA.description: Qatar has no personal income tax on salaries and wages for residents.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam levies no personal income tax on its residents, resulting in a 0% effective tax rate for individual earners.

MO.description: Macao has a low personal income tax system with significant tax-free allowances and deductions, resulting in a relatively low effective rate for this income bracket.
